description: This file defines functions and registries related to initializing and managing Azure-specific guardrails for content safety within the litellm project. It imports classes from other modules, defines the 'initialize_guardrail' function for setting up guardrails based on parameters, and maintains registries for guardrail initialization and class references.

classes.name: AzureContentSafetyPromptShieldGuardrail
classes.description: A class representing the Azure Content Safety prompt shield guardrail, imported from a relative module.

classes.name: AzureContentSafetyTextModerationGuardrail
classes.description: A class representing the Azure Content Safety text moderation guardrail, imported from a relative module.

methods.name: initialize_guardrail(litellm_params: "LitellmParams", guardrail: "Guardrail")
methods.description: Initializes and returns a specific Azure content safety guardrail object based on the provided parameters and guardrail type.
